item.feywild.feywild_music_disc.desc: Song of the Seasons - CC Davy Habets (IKIGA)
message.feywild.music_disc: Song of the Seasons - composed, mixed, and mastered by Davy Habets (IKIGA)
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_cookie: Oho- do come see me again, darling!
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_name: Thank you very much, darling! I bet you'd like to know my real name, don't you?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_cookie: Come play with me again in the Feywild!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_name: Oh! Can I give you a nickname too? My real name's a secret though! I'll never tell! Never ever!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_cookie: Hm- perhaps you won't be as boring as I thought...!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_name: How dare you nickname me like I'm some sort of magician's pet! I'll never tell you my real name! Hmph!
message.feywild.winter_pixie_name: A nickname...? I can't even remember my real name.
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_follow: Going for a walk? I'd like to come with you!
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_stay: It feels so homely here! A good place to stay while you're away, darling.
message.feywild.spring_pixie_follow: You'll take me on a adventure with you? This is gonna be great!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_stay: This place looks pretty- I'll wait for you here! Oh! What's that?
message.feywild.summer_pixie_follow: You need me to accompany you? Sigh...fine!
message.feywild.summer_pixie_stay: Don't make me wait too long! Hmph!
message.feywild.winter_pixie_follow: Can't you go out on your own...?
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_summon: Darling! What took you so long?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_summon: Oh! Where am I? Who are you? Are you taste?
message.feywild.summer_pixie_summon: How dare you summon me like I am some sort of magicians pet?
message.feywild.winter_pixie_summon: Such inconvenience...why did you summon me mortal?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_dismiss: Bah, you're so boring! I thought we where friends?
message.feywild.winter_pixie_dismiss: So annoying...Winter shall come for you...
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_ability_on: I'll start harvesting for winter is coming!
message.feywild.spring_pixie_ability_on: Hehe! Spring is the season of Love, After all!
message.feywild.winter_pixie_ability_on: I'll gather part of their soul...you can have their scrap...
message.feywild.autumn_pixie_ability_off: Yes, enough! We've put so much into this harvest, don't you agree it's time to rest?
message.feywild.spring_pixie_ability_off: Aww, you're such a bummer! Fine I'll stop! But... can we make them fly next?
message.feywild.winter_pixie_ability_off: I will cease...could you offer your soul instead?
message.feywild.summer_pixie_ability_off: I shall decide when to cease...and that moment...is now!
message.feywild.feywild_lexicon: This Lexicon appeared mysteriously in your inventory.
message.feywild.no_lexicon: You need Patchouli for this book to open up it's information to you.
